summary_1line: The Pandavas plan their incognito year in King Virata’s court, choosing disguises and roles to remain undiscovered.

image_candidates.scene_text: The five Pandava brothers gather in a forest hermitage as Yudhishthira calmly proposes living in disguise in King Virata’s court.
Yudhishthira describes his plan to appear as the dice‑playing courtier Kanka before the king of Matsya.
